notes: Dorna pure-cleric respec support. Installs Battle Priest package preferences for future native SoU cleric autoleveling: Power Attack, Cleave, Great Cleave first, then battle-caster feats; Concentration and Spellcraft are primary skills. Adds a Dorna-only prepared-spell profile that refreshes ordinary cleric slots once after each cleric level change and requires a normal rest; domain slots are preserved. Intended to pair with the supplied respec save (Dwarf, True Neutral, Tempus, Cleric 6, War + Strength). 0.8.6.29 somatic fixes, companion discipline 0.8.6.28, reader 0.8.6.26, combat core 0.7.10.7, familiar FIX5/progression and PRC_MULTISUMMON are unchanged.
